Package index

Diagnostics

The three main functions. By default (method = "WS") they use the design matrix weighted by IRLS at convergence and scaled to unit length by column, without centering; method also gives the definitions of MacKinnon and Puterman ("MP"), of the original design matrix ("X") and of the raw information matrix ("RAW").

condition_number()
Condition number of a model (collinearity diagnostic)
bkw_diagnostics()
Full Belsley-Kuh-Welsch collinearity diagnostics
rvif_diagnostics()
Redefined Variance Inflation Factor (RVIF) diagnostics

ML-collinearity

Compares the condition number of the original design matrix against that of the IRLS-weighted information matrix, following Lesaffre and Marx (1993), to tell apart ordinary collinearity among the explanatory variables from ML-collinearity.

ml_collinearity()
ML-collinearity diagnostic (Lesaffre and Marx, 1993)

Example datasets

Real data used in the examples (see the Examples menu).

Nitrogen
Nitrogen dioxide air-pollution data (Chatterjee and Hadi 1988)
Mine
Coal mine roof-fracture data
LeeCancer
Lee (1974) cancer remission data
Plastic
Plastic plywood manufacturing process data
